subject: planner: remove fix control 47400 (#64796)
summary: Diff removes the Fix47400 gate from planner cardinality estimation: column/index row-count and Selectivity now always clamp to a minimum of 1 row (subject to RealtimeCount==0 early-return / max-clamp behavior). Fix47400 remains defined but is marked deprecated; no remaining code references in planner. Later history up to upstream/master (e.g. #65854/#65900/#66304) adjusts full-range estimation and Selectivity signature but does not reintroduce Fix47400 or indicate a follow-up fix for a Blocker/High regression.
